title: Robot holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M50 42 C48 50 46 55 47 60' stroke='#7fd4e8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->

  <ellipse cx='45' cy='22' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#ff93a5'/>

  <rect x='38' y='58' width='24' height='24' rx='5' fill='#3fd0b0'/>

  <rect x='30' y='62' width='8' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd447'/>
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='8' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd447'/>
  <!-- hand holding string -->
  <circle cx='69' cy='64' r='3.5' fill='#ffd447'/>
  <path d='M69 62 C68 55 58 50 53 46' stroke='#7fd4e8' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>

  <rect x='42' y='82' width='6' height='9' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd447'/>

  <rect x='35.5' y='32.5' width='29' height='21' rx='5' fill='#2a3f6e'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='41' r='3.4' fill='#7ffce8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='41' r='3.4' fill='#7ffce8'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 52 56 47' stroke='#7ffce8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='24' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd447'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ff5470'/>
</svg>
